page_texts.1: Read `.claude/commands/tech-eval.md` for the full workflow. For a new evaluation: collects the capability need and vendor candidates, generates PES-framework evaluation criteria for user review (add/remove/weight), scores each vendor per criterion with the user, then creates `strategy/tech-evals/<name>/EVAL-<name>.xlsx` (scoring workbook from COTS template) and `EVAL-<name>.md` (context doc). For an existing evaluation, opens the subfolder for modification. Use `tech-eval list` to show all current evaluations and their status. Invokes the `/tech-evaluator` skill for the scoring workflow.
